title: Woman Jumps in Water With Child To Evade Cops
description:
One of the news channels showed the unblurred footage of the incident, where it could be seen that the woman was naked. Another team of the marine patrol caught the woman on the other side. Fortunately, the little kid didn’t sustain any injuries. The woman was charged with Child Abuse, Criminal Mischief Damage  of $200 to $1,000 and Resisting Arrest Without Violence.
